notes.title: Bugfixes arriving
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Im listening very carefully to what users are saying and will be publishing and update soon.
This first update will consist of bug fixes, especially the ones imacting gameplay. I'm aware there is resulution change bug so please if you would like to play in full screen select it from the menu options, dont resize the window, it will change the resolution in a bad way and mess up the mouse coordinate.
Along with this update, I will fix some other bugs, too.

Thank you for your patience!
